notes.title: About some crashes & bugs
notes.content:
- We are uploading small patches which we think may be the cause of these bugs however more time will be required to completely get rid of the issue.

- If you have experienced a crash while opening a new door, please let us know through Discord or discussions.

Sorry for the inconvenience, a mid-day patch will be coming in less than 12 hours, please make sure the game is up-to-date when playing.
